about: A tiny chicken-sized dinosaur that runs in chattering swarms and nips at ankles.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

prompts.text: A tiny dinosaur chirps and chatters in quick high squeaky peeps, four separate chatters with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A tiny dinosaur gives a shrill startled squeal, four separate squeals with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A tiny dinosaur squeaks in pain, five separate squeaks with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A tiny dinosaur gives a weak fading squeak, three separate times with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A tiny animal nips with a quick hissing snap, six separate nips with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Tiny quick scurrying footsteps of a small animal on dry leaves, separate bursts. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
